title: Security Consulting Engineer
teaser: Join our team as a Security Consulting Engineer to lead the design and deployment of Cisco security solutions, integrating them with customer environments. Drive technical leadership and collaborate across teams to deliver innovative, resilient security strategies. Ideal for experienced professionals in cybersecurity with a strong background in Cisco security solutions.
description:
Meet the Team 

Building the Future of Cybersecurity

The CXC APJC Security Technology group is at the forefront of Cisco’s mission to secure the digital world for customers across the globe. Our team delivers innovative, high-impact security solutions for a diverse range of clients—spanning telecommunications, finance, manufacturing, and critical infrastructure.

Work with top security experts and industry leaders.

Gain exposure to complex, high-visibility projects across the globe.

Develop advanced skills in AI, cloud, and emerging cybersecurity technologies.

Make an impact—help shape Cisco’s security strategy and customer outcomes.

Grow your career with structured learning, mentorship, and opportunities for advancement.

If you are passionate about cybersecurity, eager to take on new challenges, and ready to help secure the digital future, we invite you to apply to the CXC APJC Security Technology group.

Your Impact 

As a Security Consulting Engineer, you will:

Lead and drive technology design, deploy, optimize, migrate, and troubleshoot Cisco security solutions, integrating them seamlessly with customer environments and third-party systems

Provide technical leadership throughout project lifecycle: architecting security solutions, guiding migrations, validating designs, and serving as a focal point for proactive problem resolution, escalation support and technical guidance across Cisco and competitive technologies

Build and review design recommendations, including High-Level Design (HLD), Low-Level Design (LLD), Implementation/Change Management Plans, and build customer simulations in lab to deliver scalable and resilient solutions

Collaborate across internal and external teams to align security strategy, support presales activities, and translate business requirements into innovative, customer-focused solution designs

Leverage AI and automation to optimize complex workflows and reduce operational overhead, identify opportunities for broader team adoption, and ensure AI-informed work consistently meets high standards of accuracy and impact

Drive continuous improvement by identifying emerging security trends, mentoring team members, and championing best practices to elevate overall delivery excellence.

Minimum Qualifications 

Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cybersecurity, or a related field.

7+ years of hands-on experience in designing, deploying, and troubleshooting Cisco Security solutions (e.g., Firewalls, Cisco-ISE, Cisco Secure Workload, Email and Web Security, Secure Network Analytics, Cisco Secure Access)

Proven migration experience with Cisco and competitive security products in enterprise or service provider environments

Knowledge of cloud security architecture and deployment on at least one major cloud platform (GCP, Azure, or AWS)

Experience using AI and automation tools to enhance security operations, optimize workflows, and drive operational efficiency

Shift Requirement

Must be willing to work in a swing shift to support customers across the Americas (AMER) region

Preferred Qualifications

Technical certification: Professional level (CCNP) or Expert level CCIE Security or equivalent, CISSP/CCSA

Cloud Security certification (e.g., AWS/Azure Security/GCP)

Security Reference Architecture experience (e.g., ZTNA, NIST, 3GPP, ETSI, AI Infrastructure)

Strong communication and collaboration skills

Experience working in diverse, cross-functional teams

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
